title: Lethal autonomous weapon
extract: In general terms, lethal autonomous weapons systems (LAWS), also known as autonomous weapons systems (AWS), are types of military drones or military robots, that can independently search for and engage targets based on programmed constraints and descriptions. AWS can take several forms, such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUV) and Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGV). However, the majority of alleged AWS are, at the moment, UAVs.
